name: ABNK Harness Toolset
description: Automated toolset for Amazing Bank (ABNK) IT system. Phase 1 stack: PostgreSQL 18.3 docker（:5432，fineract_tenants + fineract_default）+ Fineract ServerApplication（Spring Boot + 内嵌 Tomcat，:8443 SSL，JDWP :5005）。Provides the debugger and doc-review actions; designed to grow into the full Amazing Bank IT stack orchestrator.

commands.abnk-debugger: Start automated debugging session for the Amazing Bank IT stack with process management, log analysis and self-directed fix scheduling
commands.abnk-doc-review: Five-dimension review of Sprint/Phase design docs (.asdm/workspace/docs/Sprints/) with code-evidence verification against the Fineract codebase
commands.abnk-prod-deploy: Deploy the Amazing Bank website (abnk-system/channels/website) to the production server via docker compose with HTTPS (amazingbank.ai). Enforces sensitive-info audit gate (Step 0) — production secrets live only in .github-private. Two-phase flow: Release Note review checkpoint, then server-side build + compose switch
